data.situation:
At home, Lin opened an envelope and laid a certificate beside her laptop. It was a vocational qualification from a course she had completed before returning to university. Her background also included several years at a small shop. She could not fit her whole life into a short application, so she chose two examples: helping a lost customer and changing a display that people kept walking past. Application draft
I have experience of helping customers and organising small displays. I am capable of working independently after training. My ambition is to organise community events of my own. Working and volunteering have given me valuable life and work experience. Maya: You have a talent for making a confusing display clear. Put that example first.
Lin: I worry that I have not run a large event.
Maya: They are offering training. You can show them your potential without claiming you know everything already.
Lin: Then I will explain what I changed at the shop and what I still want to learn.

readingBlocks.en: At home, Lin opened an envelope and laid a certificate beside her laptop. It was a vocational qualification from a course she had completed before returning to university. Her background also included several years at a small shop. She could not fit her whole life into a short application, so she chose two examples: helping a lost customer and changing a display that people kept walking past.
readingBlocks.zh: 回到家，林打开信封，把一张证书放在电脑旁。这是重返大学之前完成的课程所获得的职业资格。她的经历还包括在小店工作几年。她无法把整段人生塞进简短申请，于是选了两个例子：帮助一位迷路的顾客，以及调整一处人们总是略过的陈列。

readingBlocks.en:
Application draft
I have experience of helping customers and organising small displays. I am capable of working independently after training. My ambition is to organise community events of my own. Working and volunteering have given me valuable life and work experience.
readingBlocks.zh:
申请草稿
我有帮助顾客及组织小型陈列的经验。经过培训后，我能够独立工作。我的志向是组织自己的社区活动。工作和志愿服务让我获得了宝贵的生活与工作经验。
readingBlocks.title: On the laptop

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: You have a talent for making a confusing display clear. Put that example first.
Lin: I worry that I have not run a large event.
Maya: They are offering training. You can show them your potential without claiming you know everything already.
Lin: Then I will explain what I changed at the shop and what I still want to learn.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：你擅长把让人困惑的陈列整理清楚，把这个例子放前面吧。
林：我担心自己没组织过大型活动。
玛雅：他们会提供培训。你可以展示潜能，不必说自己什么都会。
林：那就说明我在店里改了什么，以及还想学什么。

glossary.zh: 使人适合某项工作的资格或资历

externalEvidence.definition: an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something

glossary.zh: 与职业技能或培训有关的
glossary.example: The certificate came from a vocational course.
glossary.exampleZh: 证书来自一门职业课程。

externalEvidence.definition: of or relating to a vocation or occupation; especially providing or undergoing training in special skills

glossary.zh: 个人此前的经历或教育等背景
glossary.note: background in + 领域；本例为个人经历。
glossary.example: Her background includes several years in a shop.
glossary.exampleZh: 她的背景包括在商店工作几年。

externalEvidence.definition: a person's social heritage: previous experience or training

glossary.note: be capable of + 名词或动名词，不用of to work。
glossary.example: Lin is capable of working independently after training.

externalEvidence.definition: (usually followed by `of') having capacity or ability

glossary.zh: 希望取得成就的志向或目标
glossary.note: an ambition to do something；ambition也可指追求成就的动力。
glossary.example: Her ambition is to organise community events.
glossary.exampleZh: 她的志向是组织社区活动。

glossary.zh: 宝贵的生活与工作经验
glossary.note: experience指经验时通常不可数；valuable修饰整个并列短语。
glossary.example: Volunteering has given her valuable life and work experience.
glossary.exampleZh: 志愿服务给了她宝贵的生活与工作经验。

glossary.zh: 某方面的天赋或突出能力
glossary.note: a talent for + 名词或动名词。
glossary.example: She has a talent for making displays clear.
glossary.exampleZh: 她擅长把陈列整理清楚。

glossary.zh: 可进一步发展的能力；潜能
glossary.note: 不可数名词，the potential to do something。

externalEvidence.definition: the inherent capacity for coming into being
